scenes.text: Day four. A giant bag falls from the sky.
So far, a yacht he can't leave, and a T-Rex that eats all his food every week.
And the same guy who gave him the yacht, won again.
Give him a big bag of bricks, concrete, and wood, to make a house.
One problem. He has never built anything.
So the T-Rex helps. Its tail mixes the concrete.
Its arms can't hold a hammer. So it uses its head.
The T-Rex can't fit through the door.
And its arms are too short to open it.
So he shares a fish anyway.
Day five is up to you.
A penguin? A pizza oven? A tiny volcano?
Literally anything. Top comment gets built.
